court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Shrikrishna Asaramji Revaskar vs Sau. Pushpa Shrikrushna Revaskar And ...

parties.respondent_defendant: Sau. Pushpa Shrikrushna Revaskar and others (wife and children)

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The applicant suffered orders for interim maintenance, enhanced maintenance under section 127 of the Criminal Procedure Code, and compensation under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005. The total maintenance directed is around Rs.20,000/-.

legal_principles.principle: Maintenance awarded under the Act of 2005 can be in addition to maintenance awarded under statutory provisions.
legal_principles.held: The award of said maintenance is in addition to the maintenance that is awarded under the statutory provisions of the Criminal Procedure Code and the Hindu Marriage Act.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 — Section 20(1)(d)

legal_principles.principle: Maintenance awarded should not be unreasonable in light of the applicant's income.
legal_principles.held: The maintenance awarded, in my opinion, can't be termed as unreasonable, particularly when the fact remains that the applicant is required to pay compensation.

outcome.final_order: The applicant's order impugned passed under section 127 of the Criminal Procedure Code enhancing maintenance is pending.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
